author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Yeah, I really love flash games (pretty much just small online games you play on gaming websites like Kongregate, Armor Games, Addicting Games, et cetera), so I'd like to know what your favorite(s) are!

Mine are:
Death vs. Monstars 2 
Learn to Fly 2
Kingdom Rush

Others (Sorry, it's really annoying to add in all the links :c)
Electricman 2
Raze 2
Stick Wars
Free rider 2

Just wanted to know some so I can maybe check them out :D
Hope you enjoy the lists c:

-Love, Goldie
